og.title: Glass Cleaning Course | CARSI
og.description: Professional glass cleaning technique for restoration and cleaning technicians. Streaks, smearing and scratching are avoidable with correct technique, appropriate tools and properly prepared cleaning solutions. Includes video demonstration and window track cleaning.

faq.q: When do technicians need professional glass cleaning skills?
faq.a: Restoration and cleaning technicians are frequently called on to clean glass after water damage events, construction works and renovation projects, and as part of routine commercial cleaning contracts.

faq.q: What causes streaks and scratching, and can they be avoided?
faq.a: Poorly executed glass cleaning produces streaks, smearing and scratching. All of these are avoidable with correct technique, appropriate tools and properly prepared cleaning solutions, which is what the course sets out to build.

faq.q: What is included in the course?
faq.a: The complete glass cleaning workflow: pre-job planning and preparation, the cleaning process itself, supplementary video guidance, bonus content on window track cleaning, and a knowledge assessment. Content is aligned with professional cleaning standards relevant to the Australian market.
